description: This classic American Homemade Mac and Cheese Baked is the ultimate comfort food, featuring tender pasta coated in a rich, creamy cheese sauce and baked to golden perfection. It's a heartwarming dish that brings families together, perfect for weeknight dinners or special gatherings. Experience the nostalgic flavor of a true American favorite with this easy-to-follow recipe.

instructions.title: Prepare the Pasta
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375F (190C). Cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain well and set aside. Do not rinse the pasta, as the starch helps the sauce adhere.

instructions.title: Make the Roux
instructions.text: In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the all-purpose flour and whisk constantly for 1-2 minutes until a smooth, light golden paste (roux) forms. This will prevent a raw flour taste.

instructions.title: Whisk in Milk and Seasonings
instructions.text: Gradually whisk in the warmed milk, a little at a time, ensuring no lumps form. Continue whisking until the sauce is smooth and begins to thicken, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the salt, black pepper, and dry mustard powder (if using).

instructions.title: Create the Cheese Sauce
instructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat. Add the shredded sharp cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses to the sauce. Stir gently until all the cheese is completely melted and the sauce is smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary.

instructions.title: Combine Pasta and Sauce
instructions.text: Add the cooked and drained macaroni to the cheese sauce. Stir gently until the pasta is evenly coated with the rich, creamy sauce. Ensure every noodle is covered.

instructions.title: Assemble and Bake
instructions.text: Pour the macaroni and cheese mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle the panko breadcrumbs evenly over the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the mac and cheese is bubbly and the topping is golden brown and crispy.

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Remove the mac and cheese from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving. This allows the sauce to set slightly, making it easier to serve. Serve hot as a comforting side or a satisfying main dish.

tips: Always use freshly grated cheese from a block for the best melting and flavor; pre-shredded cheeses often contain anti-caking agents that can make the sauce gritty.
Do not overcook your pasta in the initial step. It should be al dente, as it will continue to cook and absorb sauce in the oven, preventing a mushy texture.
For an extra golden and crispy topping, you can toss the panko breadcrumbs with a tablespoon or two of melted butter before sprinkling them over the mac and cheese.
